title: Compactly supported real scalar potentials realizing the Hardy uncertainty endpoint for Schrödinger evolutions
summary: At the critical Hardy Gaussian weight for the Schrödinger equation in one space dimension on $[0,1]$, the known nonzero scalar example in the weighted $L^2$ class carries a complex-valued potential. Cassano and Fanelli observed that the existence of a real-valued scalar endpoint example was open, and produced examples with real electric and magnetic potentials only after introducing a magnetic potential.
